title: Work across messages, cache, and drafts
summary: AD Tools 1.3.7 adds Kafka and Redis Cache workflows and makes it easier to manage multiple editor drafts.
notes: Kafka can publish messages, browse topics, listen live, and search retained messages by payload, key, or header.
Redis Cache can find keys in bounded pages, inspect a key's value, and clear selected keys after confirmation.
HTML Editor keeps multiple documents in tabs, with tab actions and Undo for closed tabs.
Quick Query tabs now have more flexible management and layout.
Preview adds viewport presets and VTL mode controls, and Check Image can check multiple environments in one run.

slides.title: Publish and inspect Kafka messages
slides.body: Set a bootstrap server, then work with topics and messages from one place.
bullets: Compose a payload and choose a topic to publish.
Switch to Listen for live messages or search retained messages from a chosen time.
Reuse a received message as an editable Publish draft.

slides.title: Find and inspect Redis cache keys
slides.body: Search a configured Redis connection, inspect individual values, and clear keys when needed.
bullets: Browse key results in bounded pages and keep frequently used keys close at hand.
Open a key's value to find text within it.
Review a confirmation before clearing one or more keys.

slides.title: Keep more drafts in reach
slides.body: HTML Editor and Quick Query make it easier to move between active pieces of work.
bullets: Keep separate HTML documents in tabs and use the tab menu to manage them.
Undo a bulk tab close in HTML Editor or Quick Query.

tips.title: Start with a broker
tips.body: Open Broker settings and enter a bootstrap server before testing the connection.

tips.title: Connect Redis Cache
tips.body: Open Settings to configure a Redis connection, then test it before finding keys.

tips.title: Open another document
tips.body: Select New HTML document to work in a separate tab; use a tab's menu for more actions.

tips.title: Keep queries separate
tips.body: Select New tab to start another Quick Query workspace without closing the current one.
